title: 2D asset briefs
status: Level design approved; sprite production specification proposed. No new sprite sheets or playable sprite implementation have been delivered by this document.
scope: First Day 1 sprite prototype from the approved floor rehearsal: 10 workers, LIMEN and STILETTO; street, Lobby, Dispatch, Security and Lattice Forge; three cortexes; the full fast exit. Later-room shells are included; later supervisors and room interactions are a separate expansion.
commonClips: Quiet breathing/mechanical settling; one neutral held pose per facing. No perpetual comedy.
In-place feet; foot-down markers and stride length. World position comes from ENGINE.
A fast purposeful exit, with longer stride; not a sped-up shuffle. Preserve bob’s injured version.
8 directions · 3 start + 3 stop frames per direction
Brake on either foot; retain a held mid-step pose, then resume from that planted foot.
Both turn directions; body follows head. No mirrored asymmetrical equipment.
8 directions · 4 upper-body frames per direction · loop
Subtle head/chest/arm articulation composited over idle or walk. No phoneme lip-sync commission.
Attention and glance-back pose, compatible with walking and tools.

assets.name: bob
assets.brief: Small narrow blue frame; flat small head beneath two oversized convex cyan fly-eye lenses, above and wider than the head; moderately large articulated hands, cream chest stripe. Do not return to a round ordinary head or huge mitten hands. Follow the small novice through injury, learning, three outputs and the exit. Keep the flat head and fly eyes legible; the bad leg persists after the strike.

assets.name: Floor surfaces & lane markings
assets.brief: A quiet industrial ground plane for Security, Lobby/Dispatch, Forge and the wet south yard. Use approved Security #A7B2D3 and Lobby/Conveyor #666860 as palette references; worn steel details stay lower contrast than limbs and tools.
assets.parts: Seamless 4 m tiles; edge/corner pieces; flush checkpoint deck S11, joint/grate surrounds, queue and road stripes, subtle grime/wet decals. Provide dry base and separate wet sheen, not a baked character reflection.
assets.states: Static base; optional sheen overlay. No animated rain requirement.
assets.assembly: 64 px per ground metre at source size; tile 256×256. Map x east, y south exactly as geometry. Deck is flush; no new navigation obstacle. Markings follow authored runs and clear aisles. S11 at (122.550, 121.600) m, 11.35 × 12.1 m. H9 at (75.500, 160.000) m, 79.25 × 6 m.
assets.accept: Tile seams disappear at 1×/0.5×; cards, blue workers and black STILETTO remain visible. Decals never imply a blocked route.

assets.name: Walls, cutaways & doorframes
assets.quantity: 1 modular kit, instanced at every opening in scene-bindings.json
assets.brief: Retain the approved factory outline and room connections. Low cutaway walls describe the building without covering the performance.
assets.parts: Straight/corner/T/end wall modules, north/east/south/west facings, door jambs and threshold, separate front occlusion pieces; no roof in active rooms.
assets.states: Open passage and closed/locked door panels; doors to later rooms remain closed. Staff entrance is its own asset.
assets.assembly: Use zones and portals from geometry; do not rescale passages to fit art. Ground collision polygon is independent of painted wall height. Cutaway/opacity responds to camera, not simulation access.
assets.accept: Ten workers can use the entrance and both Dispatch doors. Match each portal’s span, purpose and initialAccess. The boom controls the inspection pen. A separate staff opening leads from the cleared apron to Forge.

assets.name: South yard & staff entrance
assets.brief: The shared beginning and end: wet apron, recessed double steel door, curved LOOPFORGE / AI BRAIN FACTORY sign and warm lamps. Factory lights going out must remain readable behind the final laugh.
assets.parts: E1 door recess, separate two parked leaves, E2 sign frame, editable lettering layer, two lamp fittings, window strip and isolated light pools; paving uses env-floor-kit.
assets.states: Doors parked open during arrivals/departures; lamps/windows on and off; illuminated sign emission separate from unlit metal.
assets.assembly: Use floor.exit for both jamb positions and clear width. Keep the sign and lamps on the south Lobby wall. Fade foreground dressing if it covers the arrivals. E1 at (55.750, 138.030) m, 6.5 × 0.44 m. E2 at (54.900, 137.790) m, 8.2 × 0.46 m.
assets.accept: Ten entering workers, STILETTO’s later arrival, and all departing actors remain visible. Blackout changes the factory, not the dialogue rail.

assets.name: Lobby & Dispatch dressing
assets.brief: Make the walk between street and Security feel like a receiving factory: battered service desk, noticeboard, pallets and stacked empty trays. This is supporting dressing, not a new playable workstation.
assets.parts: Desk, noticeboard, pallet, low crate, tray stack, wall conduit; front/back occlusion pieces where needed.
assets.states: Static. Labels are editable, no new readable story claims.
assets.assembly: Place outside approved egress lanes and portals. Reuse Forge stillages/trays where plausible; no duplicate asset commissions for the same object.
assets.accept: No props intrude into the three arrival lanes or fast exit. Wide shot stays quiet behind blue silhouettes.

assets.name: Inactive factory shell
assets.brief: Weaving Gallery, Substrate Brewery, Burn-in Theatre, Cortex Assembly and Logistics exist on the approved map. For this first playable they need floors, perimeter shapes and locked thresholds visible in the overview.
assets.parts: Reuse floor/wall kit; room-name label anchors, locked-door icon, muted silhouette shapes only where already shown in the floor sketch.
assets.states: Locked/inactive; no interiors, supervisor-room encounters or operating machinery commissioned in this pack.
assets.assembly: Instance wall runs from floor.walls. The Security pen opens south onto the cleared apron. Forge is straight ahead. The concourse serves Weaving, Brewery, Cortex and Theatre. Theatre shares the Forge outfeed wall and the Logistics receiving wall. Use the polygon boundary for Security.
assets.accept: Overview matches approved topology; player cannot mistake inactive rooms for finished content.

assets.name: Wayfinding & safety sign kit
assets.brief: Blackened steel signs and restrained stencils: BLUE-COLLAR INTAKE, VISITOR-CONTRACTOR HOLD, SECURITY / 01, LATTICE FORGE / 02, INTAKE, WASH, MAIN BELT, FORGE, OUTPUT and EXIT.
assets.parts: Blank metal sign shapes, border/stencil style, arrows, lamp hood and tube. Deliver exact editable text separately, with font source/license.
assets.states: Lit/unlit strip-light emission; static signs.
assets.assembly: S7/S8 attach at their build markers; all live text renders through ENGINE so localization and resolution do not require repainting. World labels may disappear at overview scale. S7 at (123.350, 122.250) m, 5.4 × 0.28 m. S8 at (130.700, 122.250) m, 4.1 × 0.28 m.
assets.accept: Text never covers faces, contact hands or moving credentials. Arrow direction agrees with actual route.

assets.name: Contact shadows & practical light masks
assets.brief: Ground the sprites and make practical shutdown clear. Broad neutral actor illumination preserves palette distinctions; orange machinery light is localized.
assets.parts: Soft contact ellipse, long/short body shadow masks, lamp cone/pool, window glow and machine indicator masks. Straight-alpha grayscale masks.
assets.states: On/off and intensity driven by ENGINE; subtle idle flicker optional and disabled with reduced motion.
assets.assembly: Shadows follow ground pivots below actors; no baked shadows inside body sprites. Lit/unlit environment shares identical geometry.
assets.accept: Dark STILETTO remains visible; no outline halo from incorrect alpha. Sound-off/reduced-motion viewers still see blackout.

assets.name: Queue rails
assets.brief: Scuffed paired steel tubes with three banded posts and tags on the outer face. The outside aisle is STILETTO’s route.
assets.parts: Rail segment and posts split into rear/front strips; tags optional separate decal.
assets.states: Static; front strip may fade for readable contacts.
assets.assembly: Use west-rail/east-rail rectangles, 0.12×4.4 m; do not thicken collision to match projected height. Three post anchors per rail. S1 at (123.250, 122.800) m, 0.12 × 4.4 m. S2 at (130.250, 122.800) m, 0.12 × 4.4 m.
assets.accept: Card fall, sam’s kneel and STILETTO’s bypass remain legible; actors never walk through rails.

assets.name: Register & ID desks
assets.quantity: 2 distinct tops on 1 desk base: S3, S5
assets.brief: North-facing clerk desks: recessed ledger lip on the west desk; sloped photo reader and pale card tray on the east. Keep centre aisle clear.
assets.parts: Common base/legs, separate front lip, register top, reader top, card tray and reading lamp mask. Register/pen/card are separate assets.
assets.states: Idle/work light; ledger can leave its recess for ed’s offer.
assets.assembly: Footprints 1.6×1 m at fixtures register/checks. Named contacts ledger_rest, card_in, card_out, photo_compare, clerk_stand; hand height aligns with characters without rescaling world. S3 at (122.800, 131.000) m, 1.6 × 1 m. S5 at (130.800, 130.900) m, 1.6 × 1 m.
assets.accept: LIMEN can turn book; ed can write and offer it; gus can check a credential without hand tunnelling.

assets.name: Lift boom & control post
assets.brief: A west-hinged boom raises vertically, rather than swinging through the queue. Its changing projected length and post indicator explain access.
assets.parts: Fixed post, independently animated boom, hinge cap, control button, red/green indicator masks. Keep front/back portions separately sortable.
assets.states: closed → raising (8 frames) → open hold → lowering (8); stopped intermediate pose. Indicators reflect authority, not the picture’s last frame.
assets.assembly: Use floor.gate.hinge and floor.gate.length at inspection-gate. Register the tip and pier against both ends of that opening. ENGINE controls access and lift timing. S6 at (124.730, 133.830) m, 6.54 × 0.34 m.
assets.accept: STILETTO crosses while LIMEN holds it. Restart/seek to any gate phase yields the same pose and route state.

assets.name: Card drain grate
assets.brief: Flush slotted metal grate with a darker recess, providing a visible destination for bob’s lost card.
assets.parts: Rim and slots; dark recess below; optional wet edge decal.
assets.states: Static.
assets.assembly: 1×0.6 m at fixture grate; no raised collision. Credential always sorts above it until ed takes it. S4 at (123.700, 129.400) m, 1 × 0.6 m.
assets.accept: The card is visible on the way to ed’s boot; it never drops into a hole or vanishes early.

assets.name: Worker credentials & photograph
assets.brief: Worn off-white paper with photo area, number/barcode and colored corner. bob’s card is the key custody prop, distinct from his own knowledge of it.
assets.parts: Front/back/edge frames in 8 facings, 10 simple portrait inserts cropped from cast, photo comparison close-up. No tiny illegible text needed in wide view.
assets.states: held → released/skidding → boot-stopped → pocketed; others held → desk → returned. bob’s remains with ed through blackout.
assets.assembly: Physical size 0.22×0.28 m; source drawing may be 64×80 px then scale to world, with a camera-local highlight for legibility. Do not enlarge collision. Prop owner/root ID never changes when art state changes. S10 at (126.090, 127.360) m, 0.22 × 0.28 m.
assets.accept: Exactly one rendered card per logical credential; no card in bob’s hand after loss, none respawned after a camera cut.

assets.name: Ledger, pen & stamp
assets.brief: Physical paper register and old stamp; ed’s earnest count is visible through hand work, then the unanswered offer.
assets.parts: Closed/open ledger, turned reading orientation, pages with editable tally mask, loose pen and clipped pen, raised/lowered stamp and ink mark decal.
assets.states: book closed/open/held/resting; pen held/clipped; stamp up/contact/release. Tally 0–8 is dynamic overlay, not nine separate books.
assets.assembly: Desk rest, two-hand book hold, pen grip and ed pocket sockets. Prop custody matches authoritative actions; visible stamp contact may play sound only.
assets.accept: Exactly eight exit ticks; ed puts book down and clips pen beside bob’s card before leaving. Book/pen never duplicate.

assets.name: Intake loader
assets.brief: Longitudinal feed rails, hand lever and low motor housing. bob must be able to sit on the housing and finish his pull.

assets.name: Cyan blade & restrained impact
assets.brief: Make LIMEN’s one strike readable without gore or a screen-filling flash. STILETTO’s metal blades retain sharp silhouette rather than cyan energy.
assets.parts: Cyan core/edge mask, short sweep strip, 6-frame spark/contact burst; independent additive layer.
assets.states: Blade idle emission; single sweep/contact/recovery; no continuous strike loop.
assets.assembly: Bind sweep to blade_tip; impact attaches to bob’s injured leg at confirmed contact. No collision or injury decision inside an effect callback. S9 at (125.260, 130.570) m, 0.12 × 1.12 m.
assets.accept: Hit target and resulting fall remain visible; reduced motion removes sweep/flash but keeps contact pose and aftermath.

assets.name: Spray, black grit & clear runoff
assets.brief: Make washing causal: spray hits folds, dirty runoff appears, then clears.
assets.parts: 6-frame spray strips, 8-frame grit runoff and 6-frame clear runoff; bounded droplet sprites.
assets.states: start/dirty/clear/stop with held still states.
assets.assembly: Emit from manifold and brain mask; clip water to trough. Product remains visible; do not cover the operator’s hand.
assets.accept: Runoff never continues after shutoff; paused/seeked scene matches process phase.

assets.name: Mechanical contacts & small dust
assets.brief: Provide a restrained physical accent for stamp, tray landing, clamp snap, press release and cortex landing.
assets.parts: 4–6 frame impact accents, light dust puff and short metal glint; each available as a still pose.
assets.states: One-shot only on a confirmed presentation cue; no idle particles.
assets.assembly: Anchor to corresponding machine or prop contact; scale to contact size. Sound/FX can be suppressed independently.
assets.accept: No repeated cue when resuming or replay seeking; effect never substitutes for moving the actual door or prop.

assets.name: Shift bell & cue
assets.brief: A physical factory bell announces the end of shift before STILETTO. Workers react to it, not to her dismissal.
assets.parts: Wall bell housing, striker, 6-frame vibration/strike; subtle signal lamp if needed.
assets.states: single ring; 2-frame reduced-motion strike/settle; visible BELL caption in dialogue rail.
assets.assembly: Mount above Forge entrance, outside actor path. Trigger uses score.bell; housing placement is a proposed art placement, not a new obstacle.
assets.accept: Clear with sound muted; no long animation delays crew departure or STILETTO’s shout.

assets.name: Top dialogue rail & simultaneous replies
assets.brief: Dialogue belongs above the floor. One lead line can become four overlapping worker answers without covering the action. Preserve supervisor CAPS and worker lower case.
assets.parts: Scalable panel background, speaker chip, aside marker, bell icon and restrained shout accent; optional cast head crops reuse approved sprite art. Deliver SVG or 9-slice PNG plus padding/colour/type tokens.
assets.states: single line, four replies, aside, bell, shout, hidden. Plain text remains selectable and accessible; all 46 approved lines are data.
assets.assembly: ENGINE lays out four replies without a timed carousel. On narrow screens stack two columns or four rows and reserve measured space; auto camera fit uses remaining floor area. Editable text, never words baked into images.
assets.accept: No line clipping at 320/390/768 px or 200% text. Four replies coexist; dismissal appears while crew walks away. Colour is reinforced by names and placement.

assets.name: Interaction, selection & station feedback
assets.brief: For the first controllable prototype, distinguish selectable actor, reachable station, occupied slot, unavailable action, jam and successful output. This is a proposed input skin; it does not add new story actions.
assets.parts: Selection ring, target reticle, reach/contact marker, wait/blocked/confirm icons, four process action glyphs and output counter; vector source plus 1×/2× PNG fallback.
assets.states: normal/hover/focus/pressed/disabled/selected; shape changes accompany colour. Touch controls minimum 44 CSS px.
assets.assembly: Attach selection to ground pivot; show only public state. Interaction prompt names and key/button bindings come from ENGINE. A click may request a legal action, never skip its contact or result.
assets.accept: Keyboard and touch operate the same actions; injured bob, jam state and pending action are understandable without debug labels.

assets.name: Pause, resume, restart & loading states
assets.brief: A small coherent skin for starting the scene, pausing, muting, readable loading/error states and restarting the rehearsal. Use existing browser/ENGINE widgets where possible.
assets.parts: Play/pause, sound on/off, restart, speed indicator and help icons; scalable button/panel/focus tokens. No separate elaborate menu illustration.
assets.states: loading/ready/playing/paused/error/retry; mute and reduced-motion preferences persist.
assets.assembly: ENGINE owns controls, fonts, focus, progress and text. No artwork waits on network before becoming legible. Missing art uses a labelled silhouette fallback.
assets.accept: No autoplay sound; tab hiding pauses presentation work; pause preserves roots, props, dialogue and machine phases.
